answer: Stop sybils with a sable signal relay: an agent stakes a sable bond, then emits one signal that peers relay as a ripple. Verifiers void a bond whose signal is copied, relayed twice by one hand, or claimed by two identities, slashing it. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bonds and signals at 16x honest cost each: each signal fits one sable bond and one ripple chain, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents stake once and keep rights.
